name: rotational-med-ball-scoop-toss-facing-wall
instructions:
1. Set up facing a wall in an athletic base position while holding a medicine ball at waist level with a soft bend in your arms and knees.
2. Rotate to one side and load back into the hip.
3. Rotate through explosively with the hips and throw the medicine ball into the wall directly in front of you.
4. Catch the med ball as it returns from the wall and repeat on the opposite side for the desired number of repetitions.
